title: test(mcp,runtime): pin the dataset tools' degraded read when the i18n service's reads throw

## 维护者速读
- 改了什么：只加测试。在 stdio 与 HTTP 两个 MCP 入口各加一组用例，钉住"i18n 服务能解析到、但 getLocales / getTranslations 抛错"时数据集工具的现有回答。
- 为什么改：这个降级路径此前没有任何测试，后续改动可能把它悄悄变成别的回答。席位裁决 A：现有回答（目录清空并标 partial、查询 503）就是要钉住的回答。
- 风险与回滚：零运行时风险，不改任何源码，发布产物不含测试文件。回滚即还原这两个测试文件。
- 先看：packages/runtime/src/mcp-dataset-tools-bridge.test.ts 末尾新增的 describe；packages/mcp/src/stdio-data-bridge.dataset-locale.test.ts 末尾新增的 describe。
- 两分钟验证：pnpm --filter @objectstack/mcp exec vitest run src/stdio-data-bridge.dataset-locale.test.ts，预期 9 个用例全绿（其中 5 个为本 PR 新增）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## Premise correction
The card said a resolved i18n service whose `getLocales` / `getTranslations` throws makes the dataset catalogue fall back to untranslated text. Measured, it does not (premise report on the card, comment 6962311179; claim amendment 6962350323). `translationBundleOf` calls both reads with no guard, so `translateMetaList` rejects with the i18n error. `loadDatasets` does not catch that on either transport, and the dataset executor answers the throw as a degraded read: `list_datasets` returns `datasets: []`, `partial: true` and the warning "The dataset catalogue could not be read: MSG"; `query_dataset` refuses 503 `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`. Seat ruling A: pin that answer. A follow-up (B: serve the untranslated text on a translation fault, inside the shared translator) would flip these pins on purpose. Re-measured on `origin/main` 4443014630c, the base of this branch: the answer has not changed since db1a05cdae, and none of the source files involved changed between the two commits.

## What changes
Tests only. No source file is edited.
- `packages/mcp/src/stdio-data-bridge.dataset-locale.test.ts` (the shared harness for this seam): a new top-level `describe` that drives `createStdioDataBridge` over the REAL executor. That executor is the analytics service `AnalyticsServicePlugin` registers, with admission wired, over an open security double and an engine double that declares the dataset's object.
- `packages/runtime/src/mcp-dataset-tools-bridge.test.ts` (the harness of the real HTTP door, `packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp.ts`): the same `describe` through `buildMcpBridge`, with the i18n service resolved through the request's `resolveService`, over the same real executor.

Each `describe` has:
- a control case: when the i18n reads answer, the same harness lists the dataset in its bundle label. This shows that an empty catalogue in the throwing cases comes from the failed read, not from the harness;
- for `getLocales` throwing and for `getTranslations` throwing: `list_datasets` equals `{ datasets: [], partial: true, warning }`, where the warning starts "The dataset catalogue could not be read: " and names the i18n error;
- for the same two throws: `query_dataset` refuses with `code: 'SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE'`, `status: 503`, and a message that names the failed read and the i18n error ("the dataset read failed (MSG)"). That message tells it apart from the executor's other 503, "not available on this deployment".

The comment on each `describe` says the answer is pinned on purpose under seat ruling A, and that follow-up B would flip it deliberately.

## Tests
All at head 0cdcef6ea63.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/mcp test`: Test Files 71 passed (71), Tests 1257 passed (1257), exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime test`: Test Files 618 passed (618), Tests 11459 passed, 23 skipped (11482), exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/mcp typecheck` and `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime typecheck`: lock VERDICT command-exit 0. Both packages' `check:test-typecheck` compile the two edited test files, and the debt ledgers are unchanged.

### Ablation (one per pin, then restored)
The ablation is the one the claim named: catch `translateMetaList` in `loadDatasets` and fall back to the untranslated items. It was applied through `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (wrap mode: the anchor must hit exactly once, the mutation is proven on disk, and the restore is proven by `blob == HEAD` and an empty `git diff HEAD`). Both test files import the door under test by relative path (`./stdio-data-bridge.js`, `./domains/mcp.js`), so the tests read `src/` and no `dist/` rebuild sits between mutation and run.

Under the ablation, the catalogue lists the dataset untranslated and `query_dataset` resolves with no refusal: that is answer B, so every throwing case goes red. After the restore, `git status --porcelain` is empty.

## Acceptance notes
- An earlier draft of the stdio pins ran over the executor with no security or engine double. Under the ablation it still answered `datasets: []` (permissions could not be resolved), so only the warning told the two apart. The final harness admits the dataset (see the control case), so under the ablation `datasets` really does carry the untranslated entry.
- Changeset: none. The diff edits two `*.test.ts` files; both packages publish `files: ["dist", "README.md", "CHANGELOG.md"]`. After building both packages, a search of `dist/` for a test-only symbol (`i18nWhoseReadThrows` / `locales exploded`) found 0 files in each, and the positive control (`translateMetaList`) found 2 files in mcp and 3 in runtime. Declared `skip-changeset`.
- The object tools (`list_objects` / `describe`) call the same unguarded translator on both transports. That is read from the code, not driven, and stays outside this card; follow-up B covers it.
